about.description: Codebase intelligence for AI and humans: code health scores, auto-generated docs, git analytics, dead code detection, and architectural decisions via MCP.
about.head: 983a340

name: v0.56.0
body:
## What's Changed
* docs(plugin): say what the Claude Code plugin runs and what leaves the machine by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3041
* release(vscode): 0.11.0 by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3042
* fix(plugin): pass the plugin directory's checks by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3043
* fix(tests): remove claude plugin manifest claim from COUNT_CLAIMS by @justonemorenight in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3045
* fix(workspace): queue missing-fingerprint reindex under a shared database by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3044
* fix(persistence): loosen PostgreSQL columns at startup so Docker upgrades need no Alembic step by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3068
* fix(decisions): say how many decisions were kept from how many candidates by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3088

* fix(risk): pair FooTest.java, FooTests.cs and FooSpec.kt with their source by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3096

* fix(mcp): resolve Class.method and bare unique names the same way everywhere by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3099
* ci: run unit tests across all runner cores with pytest-xdist by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3098
* fix(mcp): stop searches waiting 30s for a readiness signal nothing tracks by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3115
* feat(risk): list the test files a change will probably need to edit by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3101
* fix(answer): keep the retrieval ranking first in keyless citations by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3102
* perf(update): skip history and analysis phases on a working-tree-only update by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3107
* feat(answer): serve a compact ranked shortlist on low and keyless answers by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3108
* fix(editor-files): steer agents correctly on keyless indexes and mid-edit by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3109
* feat(answer): rank files named in a stack trace or by identifier in the question first by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3116
* fix(tests): count keyless candidate_files the way the citation rule serves them by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3122
* fix(mcp): mark served targets with uncommitted edits instead of calling them fresh by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3100
* refactor(risk): one test list and no empty families in the get_risk PR directive by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3117
* perf(risk): serve the PR blast radius only on request by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3118
* fix(risk): stop risk summaries from overstating or understating a change by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3123
* refactor(risk): drop the uncalibrated structural score from get_risk replies by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3124

* feat(search): rank files the query names first and return an exact symbol alone by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3127
* feat(mcp): list every edit site of a symbol, verified against live files by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3126
* feat(mcp): accept a grep-style pattern argument as the search query by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3128

* feat(search): return matching source lines for identifier and literal queries by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3131

* fix(test-paths): count __mocks__ anywhere and the other .NET test-project suffixes by @ybai08 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2669
